expected_symptom: DXC rejects the reporter's shader because of its namespace-scope operator+ declarations; free operator overloading is not a usable HLSL construct.
summary: Feature request, not a defect: HLSL has never supported non-member (free) operator overloading, and DXC's rejection is deliberate and asserted in-tree (SemaHLSL/v2021/operators/global-overload-disallowed.hlsl). hlsl-specs proposal 0008 was Accepted in July 2025 targeting HLSL 202y. Clang trunk already compiles the reporter's shader unmodified and folds 2.0+2.0 through the free operator to float 4.000000e+00. Free operator rejected on all 16 of 20 releases that can express the repro; the 4 oldest are unmeasurable (no HLSL 2021 templates), not clean. Member-operator and renamed-free-function controls compile everywhere, isolating the restriction to free operators. v1.8.2403 added a declaration-site diagnostic (PR #5796) - a diagnostic improvement, not a regression.
text_stale: Standing maintainer comment (2023-06-30) names HLSL 202x; hlsl-specs proposal 0008 was retargeted to 202y (2025-04-01) and marked Accepted (2025-07-22). Version number only; the comment's substance was correct.
title: Free operator overload
